scope: Sequential same-device paired complete tasks, identical canonical prompts, shared configuration and real environments. Only unused L2 normalization compile-bucket specialization changes. Built-in full finite-call timings include real input processing; they are not token ITL.
idl_definition: Elapsed from logical decision readiness to finite readout delivery, including preparation, queue and state suffix computation. Direct singleton decisions are excluded; repeated references to an event are counted once.
